category_title: Low-achieving male vocational students with a preference for digital tasks over traditional writing
scenario_title: Repetitive e-mail assignments for PC specifications
minimal_context: The student is asked to type the specifications of a PC's main components and send them to the teacher via email.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For today's assignment, I need you to type out the specifications of a PC, specifically the CPU, Motherboard, Hard Disk, and Memory, and send it to me by e-mail.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Another e-mail? We just sent one about the CPU alone a few days ago.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, please complete this one as well.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm getting really tired of this repetition process. We keep doing the exact same e-mail assignments over and over.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is part of the coursework. Please keep working on it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. My motivation for these e-mail assignments is completely gone, so I'm just not going to send this one.
